# A new beginning  {#sec-end}

This is really the end of your QML journey, but just the beginning of your learning process.
As mentioned before, to be able to fully carry out a quantitative study you need to cover many more topics, which depend on the nature and topic of the specific study you are carrying out.
@sec-next listed just the major ones, but depending on your discipline there will be others that are as important.

If you are a student or staff in the Linguistics and English Language department of the University, you have access to quantitative/statistical support.
More information here: <https://uoelel.github.io/support.html>.
Don't hesitate to get in touch with Stefano.
